  error messages, recruitment status handling, and manual testing procedures.

Integrate upstream changes from PR #45, #47, and #48 with the optional portal link, contact email, and notes features:
- Reconcile Application model to support RecruitmentStage enum together with optional portalLink, email, and notes attributes.
- Update Storage to support resilient 8-column layout (company, role, completed, deadline, status, portalLink, email, notes) alongside backward compatibility for 4-field and 5-field records.
- Reconcile Main menu Option 10 to support field choices 1 through 8 (Company, Role, Recruitment stage, Deadline, Portal Link, Email, Notes, All).
- Reconcile documentation in UserGuide.md and DeveloperGuide.md, aligning recruitment stage tracking, 8-field file format, and manual testing examples.
- Update test suite to align with RecruitmentStage default ('Applied') and verify all 216 tests pass.
